summary: Phase B + C testing (Alpha Omega Phi). Backend: 30/32 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_bc.py. Phase A regression endpoints still alive. PayPal LIVE create-order works against api-m.paypal.com, returns CREATED order_id, persists pending transaction with paypal_order_id/method=paypal/purpose. Resend email blast (test_only) completes and writes a blast log; webhook synthetic payload increments opens on the matching blast_id. Frontend smoke: Navbar contains Calendar/Gear/Donate/Omega links; /omega renders heading; /gear lists 4 seeded items; /donations lists 3 seeded causes; /calendar grid renders. Admin page tabs contain Gear/Causes/Reports/Email. ONE CRITICAL BACKEND BUG: GET /api/events/calendar returns 404 due to route-ordering — the dynamic /api/events/{event_id} route is registered at server.py L734 (Phase A), BEFORE /api/events/calendar at L2273 (Phase B), so FastAPI matches /events/calendar as event_id='calendar' and 404s.

critical.issue: Route shadowed by /api/events/{event_id} (registered earlier in server.py at L734). FastAPI matches /events/calendar as event_id='calendar' and returns 404. Confirmed via curl: returns 404 for both ?month=YYYY-MM and missing param. Breaks the entire /calendar page event-loading flow.

integration_issues.issue: Calls /api/events/calendar?month=YYYY-MM which 404s due to backend route order bug above. Page degrades gracefully showing month grid + 'No events scheduled.' but never displays real events.

action_items: FIX: Reorder routes in server.py so /api/events/calendar (and /api/events/{event_id}/check-in, /api/events/{event_id}/check-ins) are declared BEFORE @api.get('/events/{event_id}') at L734. Simplest fix: move the Phase B /events/calendar endpoint definition above the Phase A dynamic-id GET — or rename the Phase B path to /events-calendar / /calendar/events. Check-in routes work because POST/DELETE methods don't collide with the GET /events/{event_id}, but GET /events/calendar definitely collides.
After fix: rerun /app/backend/tests/test_phase_bc.py — the 2 failing calendar tests will pass and frontend /calendar will show events.
critical_code_review_comments: Route order bug as above is the only critical finding.
server.py is 2898 lines — should be split (Phase A / B / C modules) for maintainability per code-review guidelines (>700 line threshold).
paypal_access_token caches token but does not handle token revocation/refresh edge case (only TTL); acceptable for now.
email/blast does Resend SDK calls inside a for-loop with asyncio.to_thread — fine for small segments but will be slow + serial for large blasts. Consider asyncio.gather batching when segment >100.

email/webhook does NOT verify Resend signature (svix-signature). Phase C says webhook URL not registered yet — but before production, signature verification should be added or the endpoint can be spoofed to inflate metrics.
personnel_brief sums total_paid across types renewal/donation/fee/gear with status==completed but does NOT include declined refunds — currently correct.
resolve_segment for segment='all' applies no filter at all (q={}) and may include deceased users; only segment='active' excludes deceased. Worth documenting/expecting in UI.

Render template uses simple str.replace and does NOT HTML-escape recipient name — XSS risk if a member name contains <script>. Low risk (admin-only feature) but worth html-escaping render_template values.

rca of the issue: Root cause of /api/events/calendar 404: In FastAPI, routes are matched in registration order. server.py defines GET /events/{event_id} at line 734 (Phase A block) which uses a path parameter that matches ANY string in that segment, including the literal 'calendar'. Phase B then defines GET /events/calendar at line 2273, but this is never reached because the Phase A dynamic route already matched and called get_event(event_id='calendar') which then 404s because no event has id='calendar'. Fix: Either (a) declare the static /events/calendar route BEFORE the dynamic /events/{event_id} route, or (b) rename to a non-conflicting prefix like /api/calendar/events or /api/events-calendar. Option (a) is the minimal change — move the @api.get('/events/calendar') function definition above line 725's @api.get('/events') section, OR re-register it on the router before the include_router() call by relocating the Phase B block.
